description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Galle District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Galle Administrative District. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, election scheduling, and electoral commission decisions.
